name: Horse boarding, riding lessons and stables

pf.license.need: none checked by Rosie: no state license to teach riding in most places; a stable registration or inspection is the owner's own word, where the state's rules ask for one (a switch from the state form)
pf.license.who: the stable for its own registration or inspection; each instructor for their own certificate, if the owner shows one
pf.license.ask: optional: the stable's registration number and any instructor certificate number the owner wants shown; nothing is checked
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never checks a license, certificate, inspection, insurance or vaccine record (D96); the stable keeps its own records
pf.license.blocks: nothing: no license or certificate blocks a booking here; the owner decides who may teach or lead a ride
pf.license.renewals: a reminder the owner sets for its own dates, if it wants one
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance is the stable's own matter; optional for the booking
pf.license.background: any background check for staff is the owner's own step, outside Rosie

pf.services.shape: a lesson books an instructor's time plus a school horse matched to the rider; group lessons, trail rides and camp weeks are seats, with horses as the limit; boarding is a stall for a horse, from a move-in date, month to month; flow B: an instructor at the customer's own farm with the customer's own horse, and pony parties at a home
pf.services.examples: the example stable's own prices (Lee Stables and Lee Horse Lessons), not a standard

list.name: Guided trail ride
list.length: about 90 minutes on the trail, with a guide
list.needs: a guide per few riders, a trail horse, and a helmet from the barn
list.note: ages 10 and up; riders up to 230 lb (the stable's limit for its trail horses); the rider's own answers stay on the secure page

list.name: Private riding lesson
list.length: 1 hour with a head instructor on a school horse
list.before: a card saved for the $40 late-cancel fee
list.note: ages 6 and up; riders up to 200 lb on the school horses

list.name: Summer riding camp (one week)
list.kind: a series of days, a seat in a session
list.after: the $350 rest paid at the barn office on the first day
list.capacity: 12 children; runs with at least 6 by 7 days before
list.note: a child is handed back only to a parent or an adult on the pick-up list

list.name: Lesson at the customer's farm, on their own horse (flow B)
list.before: a card saved for the $40 fee
list.after: the saved card is charged at DONE
list.note: the horse's vaccines and Coggins test are the owner's word, not checked; the owner is asked to OK the place

list.name: Pony party at a home (flow B)
list.where: at the customer's home, on flat grass away from roads and pools
list.after: the $300 rest paid on the bill after the party
list.capacity: up to 8 children ages 2 to 8, led by the handlers

pf.services.capacity: one rider per lesson on a school horse; a group ride or a camp seat is a seat in a session; a guide is on duty for every ride
pf.services.online: no online riding; a riding class's theory may be by video
pf.services.outOfScope: boarding (a horse kept on the stable's property with a monthly bill) is not booked by Rosie yet: an open-ended stay with its own monthly charge is a gap (Jay's rule for stays); leases, vets and farriers are outside Rosie

beforeTimes: how much riding so far: never, a few times, or rides on their own (sets the lesson, the horse and whether a trail ride fits)
for boarding: the move-in date and the kind of horse
for flow B: a farm or a home, and the town; for a lesson, the customer's own horse and an arena or flat field
afterTime: anything the instructor should know (a past fall, nerves around horses)
a favorite school horse, if there is one
securePage: each rider's weight (the stable's limit for its horses), never in a text or through the AI
the waiver with the equine activity warning where the state's rules require it, signed by each rider (a parent signs for anyone under 18)
health notes that matter for riding (pregnancy, a recent surgery or concussion, seizures, a horse allergy)
for a horse brought in for a lesson on the customer's farm (flow B): the owner's own word on the horse's vaccines and Coggins test date, and any emergency vet OK the owner sets
for a pony party: the place's ground, and the number and ages of the children
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs; for boarding, the horse's owner or someone the owner authorizes

stop.words: a rider fell and is hurt, a head injury, someone kicked or trapped under a horse, a loose horse on a road
stop.say: Call 911 now. Don't move someone who may have a neck or back injury. Stay clear of a loose horse.

goOn.words: a horse that's colicking, down, bleeding or badly lame (a boarder's own horse)
goOn.what: the stable's own line and the horse's vet first; Rosie gives no animal health advice
no riding (the stable's rule); a barn visit or a pony ride for a child can still be booked

goOn.words: a recent concussion, surgery or seizure
goOn.what: the booking waits for the instructor's private read; Rosie gives no medical advice

pf.safety.sobriety: nobody who seems drunk or high rides that day
pf.safety.gear: a riding helmet for every rider, always (given at the barn if needed); boots or closed shoes with a heel; no loose scarves
pf.safety.weather: lightning, ice, high wind or heat over the stable's limit: no outdoor riding; lessons move to the indoor arena, trail rides move or are refunded
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver with the equine activity warning
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: every rider; a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18; at a pony party, each child's own parent
steps.result: signed: it books; not signed: no riding until it's signed

steps.name: Rider's weight and level
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.result: fits a horse: it books; over the limit or not ready: another service (a draft-horse lesson or a barn visit), before any money is taken

steps.name: Barn tour
steps.result: the owner then books the move-in

steps.name: Coggins test and vaccines
steps.when: on the secure page before a horse comes on the property, and kept current while it boards
steps.who: every horse that boards or hauls in
steps.goodFor: the Coggins test: 12 months, or as the state's rules set (a switch); vaccines: the barn's yearly list
steps.result: on file and in date: the horse may come; missing or ended: it doesn't come on the property

steps.name: Board agreement
steps.when: signed on the secure page before the move-in
steps.result: signed: the move-in books; its terms set the monthly board, extras, notice to end and emergency care

steps.name: Party place check (flow B)
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.result: flat grass away from roads and pools: it books; otherwise the owner calls first

pf.first_steps.prep: wear long pants and boots or closed shoes with a heel; no loose jewelry; arrive 15 minutes early; eat and drink water first

pf.visit.checkIn: at the barn office: the check-in code and the waiver on file; the guide ticks names for a trail ride or a camp day; at the customer's farm or home (flow B): the code at the gate
pf.visit.beforeWork: every rider gets a fitted helmet; the instructor or guide checks boots, matches the horse, and checks the tack; the horse is checked sound before it works
pf.visit.changes: a ride or lesson stopped for weather or a horse that goes lame: the rest moves to the indoor arena, another horse, or a new time, with no fee for the part not given
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or the guide's roster, then DONE from the instructor
pf.visit.children: a parent stays at the barn for riders under 10; camp children are signed in and handed only to an adult on the pick-up list
pf.visit.boarding: the horse checks in on its move-in day with its papers; the barn calls the owner, then the owner's vet, if the horse is hurt or sick

pf.money.before: rides are paid in full when booked; lessons save a card for the fee; camp takes a deposit with the rest on the first day; a party takes a deposit with the rest on the bill after
pf.money.after: lessons are charged at DONE on the saved card, or paid at the barn office; the camp's rest on the first day; the party's rest on the bill after the party
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form; prepaid money kept apart where the state's rules require it
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting); a weather or animal-welfare cancel by the stable is always free
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $40 for a lesson, $50 for a camp week, $60 for a party, only with the owner's OK, and never more than what was paid now; never for weather, a sick horse, or a rider who says before the ride that they aren't fit to ride. A rider who arrives impaired (drinking in the last 8 hours, or drugs) doesn't ride and is treated like a late cancel: any fee is the owner's call.
pf.money.refunds: a ride or lesson the stable cancels is never charged; an unused camp day is refunded under the camp terms
pf.money.outside: vets and farriers are the horse owner's own vendors, paid by the owner outside Rosie
pf.money.tax: where the state's rules tax riding or boarding
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 applies: one $2 per confirmed booking; a camp week counts once
pf.money.goods: helmets for sale, boots and tack are the stable's own sale at the barn office, outside Rosie

pf.messages.never: weight, health notes, a child's details and the horse's vet records never go in a text: only the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: texts to staff name the rider, the service and the horse only
pf.messages.minors: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.licenses: each instructor's certificate and ratings are the stable's own word, shown to the owner; not checked by Rosie (D96)
pf.staff.skills: beginner lessons, jumping, dressage, trail guide, pony handler, camp counselor, barn care for boarders
pf.staff.supervision: one guide for up to 6 trail riders; a second guide for any rider under 12 on the trail; camp keeps 1 adult for 6 campers (the stable's rule)
pf.staff.oks: the head instructor OKs a rider's level for trails and jumping and reads health notes; the owner OKs fees, refunds and new boarders
pf.staff.standIn: another instructor who teaches that level may take a lesson, offered first, never assumed; a trail ride's guide may change, nothing moves for the riders
pf.staff.horses: a rider who asked for a favorite school horse is told before the ride if that horse can't work, and may keep the time with another horse or move it
pf.staff.away: only instructors cleared by the owner go to customers' farms; two handlers at every pony party
pf.staff.certificates: each instructor's certificate end date, if the stable enters one: a reminder for the owner only

pf.rules.equine: where the state's equine activity rules apply: the warning notice in the waiver and posted at the barn (a switch)
pf.rules.helmets: helmets for riders under the age the state's rules set (a switch), and always for every rider under the stable's own rule
pf.rules.health: the Coggins test and any health certificate for a horse that crosses state lines, as the state's rules require (a switch)
pf.rules.boarding: where the state's rules set what a board agreement must say or what happens to a horse whose board isn't paid, those switches apply; Rosie never starts a lien or sells a horse
pf.rules.welfare: school horses rest as the stable's rule says, and never work lame or sick
pf.rules.records: waivers, incident notes and boarding papers kept 7 years, longer for minors where the state asks
pf.rules.scope: the stable's staff don't diagnose or treat a horse or a rider; a vet is called by the owner, where the state's rules require one

pf.edges.weather: weather over the limit: lessons move to the indoor arena; trail rides and pony parties move or are refunded, with no fee
pf.edges.horseOut: a school horse lame or sick: another horse that fits the rider, or a move with no fee
pf.edges.overWeight: a rider over the limit: another service, told privately before any money
pf.edges.fall: a fall: first aid, 911 if serious; a parent called at once for a child; incident notes on the secure page
pf.edges.boarderSick: a boarded horse hurt or sick: the barn calls the owner, then the owner's vet; the emergency care OK is used only when the owner can't be reached
pf.edges.coggins: a boarded horse's Coggins test about to end: the owner is reminded; ended: the barn decides under the agreement
pf.edges.latePickup: a camp child not collected: stays with staff; the parent, then the emergency contact, is called
pf.edges.moveOut: a boarder gives notice: the last month as the agreement says; the stall deposit back after move-out
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
